about: A Python library with trading days and hours for stock exchanges around the world.

prs.title: Hong Kong half days close at noon
prs.broken: The Hong Kong exchange closes at noon on the eves of Christmas, New Year and Lunar New Year, but the calendar showed a normal 4 pm close.
prs.changed: Those half days now close at 12:00, matching the exchange's published hours.
prs.matters: Trading tools and backtests stop expecting an afternoon session that does not happen.
